data.Name: Honor Duel
data.Description: A creature roughly the size of a potato waddles up to you, slaps you with a tiny glove, and declares an honor duel. It's wearing a monocle and has the most serious expression you've ever seen on something that small.
data.Outcomes: [{"probability": 0.40, "type": "player_choice", "text": "The tiny creature assumes a fighting stance. It has clearly been training for this moment its entire life.", "params": {"choices": [{"name": "Accept the Duel", "risk": 0.3, "success": {"type": "spawn_ally", "text": "After a surprisingly dramatic battle, it bows and declares you worthy! It pledges its tiny sword to your cause.
